fieldValues.title: Pin advance: SRS_RUST_CLI_TAG -> v0.1.0-build.353
fieldValues.summary: Step 4 of the revision-bump choreography. Bumped SRS_RUST_CLI_TAG in .github/workflows/release-drift.yml from v0.1.0-build.331 to v0.1.0-build.353 (6ce3e71, carrying srs-rust#984/#975/#974/#969) and re-rendered with publish-spec.mjs. Render delta: none -- docs/spec/** byte-identical between the two builds. Both gates (validate-all.mjs, check-release-drift.mjs) pass by exit code.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs gate:pool queue via srs#580 tick 2026-09-08 ~13:20Z (comment 5585865314). Executes rfc-decision-693b9458 (Door 1). Ground: local checkout was a shallow clone; per carried-context-6c231a2a it was unshallowed (git fetch --unshallow) before trusting check-versioning-cell.mjs/check-repository-cell.mjs, which need full git history -- a shallow checkout made the versioning-cell allowlist entry (value_range.json) look stale when it is not. PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/689 (auto-merge armed, gate:auto-merge).
